source_window.label: Exeter City Council Brownfield Land Register 2025 source-area/map window

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an existing Exeter building, bound to explicit building type/use evidence. Exeter City Council's Brownfield Land Register 2025 is an official public planning-site register for previously developed land suitable for residential development, with a brownfield-sites map and downloadable OGL data/location plans; those source-area/site boundaries are not individual physical building footprints and the selected source window exposes no record-level existing-building polygon bound to explicit type/use, so no building record was accepted.
